exposure: Women undergoing cesarean for other indications
Women undergoing cesarean for labor dystocia
Cesarean for labor dystocia vs. all others
Cesarean for labor dystocia vs. cesarean for other indications vs. vaginal deliveries
cohort: 224 nulliparous women in spontaneous labor at ≥36 weeks
finding: The study was unable to confirm the hypothesis that F dominance of the electrohysterogram is associated with vaginal delivery and lack of F dominance is associated with cesarean for dystocia.
mod_finding: The proportion of fundal dominant contractions in the electrohysterogram was not significantly different between women who had a cesarean delivery for labor dystocia and those who did not.
